segmentos.texto: My downstairs neighbor kept leaving notes, asking me to stop pacing at three in the morning. I live alone. So I set up a camera.
What the police found inside that closet was even worse. The full story is on The Quiet Hours.

estilo: Cinematic still photograph, vertical 9:16 composition, 35mm film, night, muted desaturated colors, low contrast, cold winter tones, subtle film grain, realistic, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.

planos.prompt: A handwritten note in blue ink taped to a white apartment door in an old stairwell, handwriting blurred and unreadable, cold morning light.
A small white Wi-Fi security camera on top of a bookshelf in a dark living room, its tiny light glowing.
A phone lying on a blanket in the dark lighting up with a notification banner, text blurred and unreadable.

Grainy black and white night vision security camera footage, vertical framing, high angle, wide angle lens distortion, low resolution, no text: a thin barefoot man in a gray hoodie standing still in the middle of a dark living room, hands folded in front of him.

Grainy black and white night vision security camera footage, vertical framing, high angle, wide angle lens distortion, low resolution, no text: a thin barefoot man in a gray hoodie walking slowly toward a dark hallway, seen from behind.

Grainy black and white night vision security camera footage, vertical framing, high angle, wide angle lens distortion, low resolution, no text: a thin man in a gray hoodie in a kitchen lit only by an open refrigerator, eating from a container with his fingers, then stepping into a narrow hallway closet.
A narrow closed coat closet door at the end of a dark apartment hallway at night, a thin line of darkness under it, nothing else.
